These slender yellow beeswax taper candles are made for tablescapes, centerpieces, and party décor — the kind of warm, flickering glow that makes any gathering feel intentional. Their natural golden color comes straight from the hive, no dyes added.

100% pure beeswax, 100% cotton wick. Dripless, smokeless, and handmade in the USA.

  • 100% pure beeswax — no fillers, no paraffin, no synthetic dyes
  • 100% cotton wick — smokeless and dripless
  • 6" tall × 3/8" diameter
  • Approx. 30 minute burn time per candle
  • Natural golden yellow color — no dyes
  • Fits most standard candle holders
  • 25 candles per pack
